description:
Si-Yul, who had worked hard to save up a security deposit for rent so he could leave the orphanage and live on his own, was swindled out of his savings. To raise the money again, at the urging of his best friend and fellow orphanage resident, he reluctantly takes on a dangerous, high-paying part-time job delivering drugs. While making a delivery to a club as usual, Si-Yul is caught by U Hyeon-Se, the club’s owner, who is famous for his good looks. He begged and pleaded for his life and barely managed to escape that situation, but it wasn’t long before he was caught again. As if by a twist of fate, during their third encounter, he ends up owing him a huge debt.

*“You say you don’t have any money, so what else can I do? You’ll have to pay me back with your body.”*

Their relationship began with a casual remark that sounded like a threat but wasn’t quite one, but before he knew it, a strange chemistry began to develop between them…

*“What if I refuse?”
“I’ll probably make things a little more annoying for you than they are now, Kwon Si-Yul.”
“Are you saying you’ll torment me?”
“I’m saying we’ll see each other more often.”*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
